headline: Morocco: S&P maintains OCP's 'BBB-' rating despite supply crisis
summary: S&P Global Ratings affirmed Moroccan phosphate and fertiliser producer OCP's BBB- rating with a stable outlook, saying the company can absorb pressures on its operations. S&P expects a deterioration in some metrics.
why: OCP is a major global phosphate and fertiliser producer and a key state-linked company in Morocco, so its credit rating affects its borrowing costs.
original_headline: Maroc : S&P maintient la note « BBB- » d’OCP malgré la crise des approvisionnements
